questions.id: Assemble a system to track inventory levels in a store
questions.stem: A store owner wants to keep track of the number of items in stock for each product. Which system would best help them manage their inventory?

choices.A: A simple notepad and pen to write down counts
choices.B: An Excel spreadsheet with columns for product name, current stock, and reorder threshold
choices.C: A paper-based card file sorted by product category
choices.D: A manual flagging system where employees raise a physical flag when stock is low

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because an Excel spreadsheet allows for easy organization, sorting, and calculation of inventory levels. It also enables tracking reorder thresholds and provides flexibility for updates.
questions.explanation: An Excel spreadsheet offers advantages like automation, sorting capabilities, and ease of updating compared to manual methods like notepads, card files, or physical flags.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A or C may result from a preference for simplicity or familiarity with traditional methods, but they lack the functionality needed for efficient inventory management. Choosing D could be due to a misunderstanding of the need for automated tracking.

questions.id: Design a system for scheduling appointments at a clinic
questions.stem: A medical clinic needs to manage patient appointments efficiently. Which system would best help them schedule and track appointments?

choices.B: A shared Google Calendar with color-coded events
choices.C: A paper appointment book organized by date
choices.D: A manual phone call system where patients call to confirm their slots

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because a shared Google Calendar allows for easy scheduling, visibility, and updates for both staff and patients. It also enables reminders and prevents double bookings.
questions.explanation: A shared Google Calendar provides features like real-time updates, automatic reminders, and multiple user access, making it more efficient than manual methods like whiteboards, paper books, or phone calls.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A or C may result from a preference for simplicity or familiarity, but they lack the coordination and communication needed in a clinic setting. Choosing D could be due to underestimating the benefits of digital tools for appointment management.

questions.id: Create a system for monitoring water usage in a home
questions.stem: A homeowner wants to track their household's water consumption to conserve resources. Which system would best help them monitor and analyze water usage?

choices.A: A manual logbook with daily entries of water用量
choices.B: An IoT device connected to the main water meter that sends real-time data to a smartphone app
choices.C: A visual gauge attached to each tap to show current water flow
choices.D: A neighbor who periodically checks and reports the water meter reading

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because an IoT device with real-time data provides accurate, up-to-date information on water usage, enabling efficient monitoring and conservation efforts.
questions.explanation: An IoT device connected to the main water meter offers advantages like automatic data collection, real-time updates, and easy analysis compared to manual methods like logbooks, visual gauges, or relying on a neighbor's assistance.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A or C may result from a preference for simplicity or low cost, but they require more effort and may lead to inaccuracies. Choosing D could be due to underestimating the need for continuous monitoring and data analysis.

questions.id: Develop a system for managing customer orders at an online store
questions.stem: An e-commerce business needs to manage customer orders effectively. Which system would best help them process, track, and fulfill orders?

choices.A: A paper order form that customers fill out and mail in
choices.B: A custom- built web application with order tracking and inventory management integration
choices.C: A social media platform where customers place their orders through direct messages
choices.D: A group email address where customers send their order details

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because a custom-built web application integrates order processing, tracking, and inventory management, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in handling customer orders.
questions.explanation: A custom web application provides features like automated order processing, real-time inventory updates, and order tracking, making it more efficient than manual methods like paper forms, social media platforms, or group email addresses.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A or C may result from a preference for simplicity or cost savings, but they lack the automation and integration needed for smooth order management. Choosing D could be due to underestimating the complexity of managing orders through email.

questions.id: Implement a system for tracking employee attendance in an office
questions.stem: An office manager needs to monitor employee attendance accurately. Which system would best help them record and manage attendance data?

choices.A: A physical punch clock where employees manually clock in and out
choices.B: A mobile app that allows employees to check-in and  -out with GPS verification
choices.C: A daily sign-in sheet where employees write their arrival and departure times
choices.D: An honor system where employees report their own attendance via email

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because a mobile app with GPS verification provides accurate, automated tracking of employee attendance, reducing errors and bias.
questions.explanation: A mobile app with GPS verification offers advantages like automatic time recording, accuracy, and reduced human error compared to manual methods like punch clocks, sign-in sheets, or self-reported attendance.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A or C may result from a preference for familiarity or simplicity, but they can lead to inaccuracies and potential manipulation. Choosing D could be due to trust in employees' honesty, but it lacks accountability and efficiency.

questions.id: Design a system for monitoring air quality in a city
questions.stem: A local government wants to ensure clean air for its citizens. Which system would best help them measure and report air quality data?

choices.A: Stationary sensors placed at strategic locations around the city, connected to a central database
choices.B: Volunteers who take daily readings using handheld devices and submit the data manually
choices.C: Weather balloons equipped with air quality sensors that collect data while flying over the city
choices.D: Satellites orbiting Earth that provide air quality information for the entire planet

questions.solution: Option A is the best choice because stationary sensors placed around the city provide consistent, reliable data on local air quality, which is essential for effective monitoring and decision-making.
questions.explanation: Stationary sensors offer advantages like continuous monitoring, localized data, and automatic data collection compared to manual methods like volunteers or weather balloons. Satellites may provide global data but are less suitable for city- specific air quality management.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B could result from a preference for community involvement, but it relies on human effort and can lead to inconsistent data. Choosing C might be due to the misconception that weather balloons offer better coverage, but they are not designed for continuous monitoring. Choosing D could be because of the assumption that satellite data is more accurate, but it may not capture local variations.

questions.id: Create a system for managing student grades in a school
questions.stem: A school needs to track and report students' academic performance. Which system would best help teachers manage and share grade data?

choices.A: Paper- based grade books kept by each teacher
choices.B: A shared online platform with automated calculations and progress reports for parents
choices.C: Regular email updates sent by teachers to parents
choices.D: An in-person meeting between teachers, students, and parents at the end of each term

questions.solution: Option B is the best choice because an online platform enables efficient grade management, automated calculations, and real-time communication with parents, ensuring transparency and consistency.
questions.explanation: An online platform provides features like automatic calculations, progress reports, and easy access for teachers and parents, making it more efficient than manual methods like paper-based books, email updates, or in-person meetings.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing A may result from a preference for simplicity or familiarity, but it can lead to errors and lacks transparency. Choosing C or D could be due to underestimating the need for automated grade tracking and real-time communication between teachers and parents.
